data.description:
## Story

As a CI orchestrator, I want exactly one LLM-review pipeline per PR per SHA, so that the cycle-end arbiter (story b1b6, on main), the cycle-ledger writer (story 5621, pending), and the review.max_cycles cap (story 35b8, merged) operate on an unambiguous canonical PR-side flow that is symmetric to the local /dso:commit path (story 7034, pending).

## Rationale (why this is on-scope for epic b575)

Two PR-side workflows currently run `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` on every push to `story/**`, `bug-batch/**`, `fix/**` branches with an open PR:

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `llm-review` job on `pull_request` (required check via required-checks.txt)
- `.github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml` — `Per-Story LLM Review` job on `push`

This duplication is pre-bug-3914-0848-faad-4f6a vestigial — that earlier bug broadened ci.yml's pull_request trigger; per-branch-review.yml's push trigger is now redundant. Filed and analyzed in bug f127-03ef-fd14-4da1 (closed; moved to this story).

Under duplicate workflows, epic invariants break:

| Epic invariant | Breakage |
|---|---|
| cycle-ledger integrity (5621) | 2 ledger entries per SHA → cycle_num ambiguous; cross_cycle_pattern undefined |
| arbiter dispatch dedup (b1b6 on main) | 2 arbiter dispatches → duplicate orphan-tasks (DEFER) + duplicate defense-store rows |
| review.max_cycles enforcement (35b8) | effective cap is 2 * max_cycles |
| SC10 E2E PR validation (c4f1) | "arbiter fired on a real PR" — which run is THE cycle-N? |
| Parity local+PR (epic SC) | local has 1 entry point; PR has 2 — asymmetric |

## Done Definitions

- [ ] DD1: `.github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml` deleted. Pre-deletion verification: diff the job list against ci.yml and confirm no unique job (actionlint, shellcheck, lint-python, test-hooks, test-scripts, validate-required-checks, mirror-defenses-to-pr, llm-review) is present only in per-branch-review.yml. If any unique configuration exists (different timeout, conditional dispatch, distinct env), migrate it to ci.yml before deletion.
- [ ] DD2: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `llm-review` job remains the sole PR-side consumer of `ci-llm-review-runner.sh`. No new workflow file invokes the runner on push.
- [ ] DD3: `required-checks.txt` continues to list `llm-review` (unchanged). The branch ruleset on main continues to enforce it. This DD verifies the merge-blocking surface is preserved.
- [ ] DD4: Behavioral test (under `tests/scripts/` or `tests/workflows/`) asserts that for a typical sprint flow PR (`story/<epic-id>/<story-id>-scoped` → PR to main), exactly one `llm-review` job appears per SHA in `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/actions/runs?head_sha=<sha>` output. Test uses a recorded fixture from PR #214's CI runs.
- [ ] DD5: `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md` and `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` updated to document ci.yml as the single PR-side entry point. Remove references to per-branch-review.yml. Add a one-line note in CLAUDE.md if and only if doc-router.md gates direct it (do NOT default to CLAUDE.md).
- [ ] DD6: Migration note: PRs in flight when this lands lose their `Per-Story LLM Review` check on next push. The required `llm-review` check still gates merge, so coverage is preserved — no manual intervention needed on in-flight PRs.

## Considerations

- [Consumer impact] The `Mirror Tracker Defenses to PR` job appears in both workflows (both `skipping` in PR #214 listings). Confirm ci.yml's instance is the canonical one wired to `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` and `review-github-defense-store.sh`.
- [Defense store key consistency] `review-github-defense-store.sh` keys by `pr_number + sha`. Going from 2 runs to 1 doesn't change the key — existing PR comments / defenses replay correctly on cycle 2+.
- [Onboarding] `plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/provision-ruleset.sh` reads required-checks.txt. No change needed since required-checks.txt is unchanged.

## TDD

Testing mode: UPDATE (modifies existing workflow files + adds a behavioral test asserting single-run invariant).

## Out of scope (this story)

- Changes to `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` or `dso_ci_review/runner.py` (those belong to story 5621).
- Changes to local `/dso:commit` review wiring (those belong to story 7034).
- Changes to the arbiter agent or its Python implementation (story b1b6, merged).

## Dependency intent

- depends_on: 62c9-46f5-f287-4c24 (the v1.1.0 schema recovery on PR #214 must land first to avoid mid-flight conflicts on workflow files)
- blocks: 5621-06be-ac4b-4903 (5621's cycle-ledger writes need a single canonical pipeline)
- blocks: 7034-071c-82b1-4cae (parity rationale)
- blocks: c4f1-c18d-0000-4001 (SC10 validation needs an unambiguous single PR-side run)
data.title: As a CI orchestrator, ci.yml is the sole PR-side LLM-review entry point — per-branch-review.yml is removed so each PR runs exactly one review pipeline per SHA
